description: Ideally located in the heart of Paris, we invite you to settle in a beautiful brand-new apartment.We offer you to live like a Parisian: whether you are in the capital for business or tourism, solo, with family or friends, you will find yourself at home in the French capital, for a typical stay, opening many new horizons.The spaceThis beautiful apartment has a fully equipped kitchen, 3 queen size beds, 2 confortable sofa beds, 3 bathrooms, heating, quality linens and towels as well as toiletries.We also provide high-speed WIFI, a flat-screen TV, a Nespresso coffee machine and many hospitality products.A high chair and a baby cot can be provided upon prior request.Guest accessA code will be provided in order to give you the access to the apartment.Other things to noteTo ensure the serenity of your stay, we ask for a guarantee. You can choose between a security deposit of €500 or a deductible of €69.
